name: Canada Packers Inc
summary: Canada Packers Inc. focuses on providing pork products that are raised without antibiotics (RWA). The company's operations are fully integrated, overseeing the entire process from hog farming and processing to creating innovative, value-added products. It supplies a variety of goods to numerous clients throughout North America, and extends its reach internationally to Mexico, China, South Korea, Japan, and the Philippines, supported by local representative offices. Founded in 1927, Canada Packers Inc. is based in Mississauga, Canada.
